messages.content: "你能幫我規劃一下我的一天嗎？我需要從位於123 Main Street的我家到我位於456 Park Avenue的辦公室，我不想花超過30美元的交通費。下班後，我需要從789 Broadway的全食超市訂購雜貨。我需要的東西有牛奶、麵包、雞蛋和蘋果。我不想花超過10美元的運費。然後，我需要從辦公室搭乘交通工具到我朋友位於321 Elm Street的家，我不想花超過20美元的交通費。最後，我需要從朋友家搭乘交通工具回到我家，我不想花超過25美元的交通費。你能幫我處理這一切嗎？"

function.name: grocery_delivery_order
function.description: Order grocery items from a specific location with optional delivery price limit Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location of the grocery store

max_delivery_cost.description: The maximum delivery cost. It is optional This is a float type value.

function.name: ride_hailing_get_rides
function.description: Find ride from source to destination with an optional cost limit Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

source.description: The starting point of the journey

max_cost.description: The maximum cost of the ride. It is optional This is a float type value.
